mode: read-only audit; only this report was created
scope: Adversarial reconciliation of the operational UI walker and its current receipt against the authoritative 827-control inventory and current operational-gap-ledger projection.

verdict.reason: The walker records navigation, visible DOM summaries, screenshots, and two unsaved builder deltas. It neither joins observations to stable control_id values nor records the profile stages, authority, effects, receipts, source requery, recovery, persistence, or reload/reopen evidence required to disposition an inventory control. The current ledger independently projects zero operational controls and zero examined surfaces.

current_ledger_projection.interpretation: The 123 dispositions are gap links, not operational interaction-chain completions. The walk receipt cannot upgrade them because it contains no stable control bindings or complete stage evidence.

receipt_observations.declared_authority: live installed VS Code host and real workspace; navigation-only dashboard walk
receipt_observations.statically_targeted_note: This is only selector-level source coverage: fourteen semantic navigation actions, toggleAdvanced, agent/workflow draft open, two agent additions, four workflow canvas additions/layout actions, four editor-tab actions, and two modal closes. Optional selectors and the conditional advanced toggle are not logged as per-control attempts.
receipt_observations.identity_mismatch_detail: Every navigation result contains the installed-host/source asset identity mismatch (host 9cd9ca36ef92546b versus source 8a228878f9f7ff03).

interaction_profiles_required.local_view: rendered control -> delegated handler -> bounded in-memory state mutation -> render -> declared vscode.setState -> reload reconstruction
interaction_profiles_required.read_query: load/action -> requestId-bound message -> contract validation -> host dispatch -> bounded reader -> typed result -> requestId check -> render -> retry/error state
interaction_profiles_required.write_operation: exact control/modal -> browser validation -> message validation -> retained authority/approval -> backend effect -> typed receipt -> source requery -> visible result; failures fail closed
interaction_profiles_required.host_ui: webview action -> validated host message -> native VS Code UI -> host-owned result boundary
interaction_profiles_required.durable_run: authenticated admitted revision -> ephemeral inputs -> approval -> durable run ID -> lifecycle controls -> terminal/reconciliation receipt

findings.title: No stable-control denominator join
findings.detail: The walker discovers runtime data-surface values and emits result objects by surface name. It never loads operational_surface_inventory.json, emits control_id, verifies 827 unique records, or fails on missing/duplicate inventory controls.

findings.title: Presence is recorded instead of interaction-chain execution
findings.detail: inspectSurface collects headings, visible data-action literals, panel counts, text, overflow, errors, and graph geometry after a navigation click. Visible actions are not invoked and no before/action/dispatch/result/acknowledgement/recovery chain is captured.

findings.title: Two semantic inventory surfaces are absent
findings.detail: skill-studio has no builder walk. studio-lifecycle is intentionally avoided because save, approval, execution, and lifecycle actions are not clicked. Their 22 and 43 controls respectively have no receipt region.

findings.title: All thirteen control kinds lack complete chain evidence
findings.detail: The receipt has no typed records for acknowledgement, command, editor, failure_recovery, field, form, gesture, indicator, lifecycle, menu, persistence, or reload_reopen controls. Action literals are presence observations; even the 29 statically targeted action IDs lack complete profile evidence.

findings.title: Skipped mutating controls have no per-control disposition
findings.detail: A global limitation says approval, installation, execution, and destructive controls are not clicked. It does not identify each skipped control_id, declaring authority, exact effect/reason, prerequisite evidence, or return condition. Therefore skipped controls cannot be reconciled against the 827 denominator.

findings.title: Variant identity is discarded
findings.detail: Visible action records retain data-action, label, and disabled only. Placement/variant attributes such as row, kind, scope, tab, direction, or lifecycle action are dropped. Ten observed surface/action pairs map to multiple inventory IDs; exact attribution is impossible from the receipt.

findings.title: No persistence, reload/reopen, or negative recovery pass
findings.detail: The run uses one connected webview session, does not close/reopen or reload and reconstruct state, does not inject bounded invalid inputs or failed responses, and does not prove retry, cancel, stale-result rejection, or fail-closed behavior.

findings.title: Installed host and audited source differ
findings.detail: All fourteen navigation results report host-assets-differ-from-source. A receipt from host asset identity 9cd9ca36ef92546b cannot establish behavior of source identity 8a228878f9f7ff03 without an explicit equivalence proof.

findings.title: Screenshot evidence is incomplete
findings.detail: Ten of eighteen attempted screenshots failed. Failure retention is good recovery evidence for the screenshot mechanism, but screenshots cannot supply the missing per-control chain fields and do not cover every surface.

findings.title: Current ledger explicitly remains open
findings.detail: The projection reports 827 known controls, 123 gap dispositions, 704 undisposed controls, zero operational controls, zero examined surfaces, and all twenty surfaces not yet examined. No receipt-only inference may override that projection.

bounded_safe_enhancement_design.objective: Produce exactly one deterministic terminal record for each of the 827 inventory controls while exercising only read-only or provably reversible non-authoritative UI behavior.
minimal_changes: Load and hash registry/operational_surface_inventory.json at startup; materialize a map by control_id and fail before interaction unless the denominator is exactly 20 surfaces and 827 unique controls.

Add stable data-control-id attributes where practical; otherwise use an explicit checked resolver keyed by surface_id, kind, label, and all variant attributes. Never infer a row/placement variant from data-action alone.

Emit one per-control record with control_id, surface_id, kind, interaction_profiles, selector/resolver, rendered, visible, enabled, attempted, terminal_disposition, stage evidence, timestamps, before/after state digests, authority, declared_effects, observed_effects, screenshot references, and errors.

Use a fail-closed effect classifier before every interaction. The default allowlist is observe-only indicators/acknowledgements, read queries, host UI that only opens a view, and ephemeral unsaved draft edits whose authoritative workspace/backend digest is unchanged after cleanup.

Execute profile-specific stage assertions: requestId and typed-result correlation for read_query; delegated handler/render/state restoration for local_view; native host target observation for host_ui. Do not mark a profile complete when any required stage is absent.

For reversible builder controls, capture canonical draft before, interact, assert the expected in-memory delta, close without submit, reopen a fresh draft, and verify the authoritative inventory/catalog/workspace digest is unchanged. Record cleanup in a finally path.

For each non-allowlisted control, emit skipped_requires_authority with the exact authority currently held, the specific potential effect, the missing approval/isolation/evidence, and a machine-checkable return condition. A global limitations sentence is not sufficient.

Run reload/reopen and fault-injection passes only in an isolated disposable VS Code profile/workspace with explicit authority. Until then, persistence, reload_reopen, failure_recovery, write_operation, and durable_run stages remain skipped rather than passed.

At completion, sort records by control_id, reject duplicates/unknown IDs, require exercised plus skipped plus blocked plus not_rendered equals 827, and write aggregate counts derived only from those records.

required_skip_record.authority: Exact authority held by this run, normally live-host read-only plus reversible ephemeral UI only.
required_skip_record.reason: Specific potential effect, such as workspace write, backend revision creation, install/uninstall, process execution, approval consumption, lifecycle transition, cancellation, cleanup, or destructive action.
required_skip_record.return_condition: Exact condition for a later run, including explicit effect authority, isolated disposable target where needed, current pre-state digest, rollback/recovery plan, and expected receipt/acknowledgement evidence.

safety_bounds: No submitStudioDraft, install, uninstall, enable, disable, update, run, pause, cancel, stop, resume, cleanup, reconcile, claim, release, memory capture, configuration write, or destructive control without separate exact authority.
No interaction when installed-host and source asset identities differ.
Register the disposable profile/workspace and child process before creation; reconcile them on success, failure, timeout, or cancellation.
Capture authoritative pre/post digests and fail the run if a supposedly non-mutating control changes backend, workspace, repository, extension installation, or durable run state.
Keep timeouts per control and continue to a terminal evidence record; never silently omit a control because it is hidden, disabled, absent, or timed out.
acceptance: Exactly 827 unique per-control records match the inventory hash used by the run.
Every record has one terminal disposition and profile-stage evidence or an exact skip authority/reason/return condition.
No source/host identity mismatch is present.
All exercised non-mutating controls have unchanged authoritative pre/post digests and retained cleanup evidence.
Aggregates are reproducible from per-control records; no aggregate claim is accepted without its denominator records.
